metrics.tip: Unique reference(80,30) node, actual xy=coordinates+lift+fluctuation; unsigned finite bottom/left/right segment distance in mm.
metrics.rays: Continuous finite bottom/left outward first-ray hit on physical mechanism edges excluding symmetry cut; null means no hit, not zero. Positive hit may be exit if origin inside solid.
metrics.region: Cross-region convex Q1 cell-union interior overlap plus closed-region boundary intersections; symmetry cut included only for closed regions, not ray physical edges. Not mechanism self-overlap or certified set containment.
metrics.solid_min_J: minimum saved integration-point J on original solid mask
metrics.medium_min_J: minimum saved integration-point J on non-solid cells excluding fixed workpiece cells
metrics.medium_max_abs_Hu: maximum absolute saved Hu component on that free-medium mask
metrics.strain: Binary64 in-plane Green=(F^T F-I)/2 eigenvalues from saved F; not fresh HP and not full3D principal values
metrics.peak_field_plots: Per-cell solid maximum in-plane Green principal, free-medium quadrature meanJ, free-medium Hu Frobenius norm; these differ from CSV minima/componentmax
metrics.body_forces: Minus cached global internal weak forces at all body nodes; fsum resultants/moments, not new mechanics/assembly or face traction. Four disjoint node groups include cut/interior; no owner-face attribution.
metrics.mirror: Visual reflection about y40 with arrows Fy flipped; no extra solved DOFs or pressure/grip inference
metrics.displacement_and_force_scale: Actual deformation x1; common force glyph4mm at max nodal norm across all14/components is display scale, not displacement or pressure.
